notes.title: Update for v2.0r1
notes.content: In game music added. Thanks to https://casperwhitehead.wixsite.com/pixeljuice-music

notes.title: Nearly there
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25718234/57b09307f79f54641adb8af02f18dd9872b87523.jpg

A final beta is now available on the beta branch. It's been a while but V2 is almost here.

In this latest version:
- Leaderboard option to show top scores
- Better support for Valve Index Controllers
- Energy bar broken up a bit
- Lots of tutorial updates/fixes
- Other minor fixes.

notes.title: New Release v1.0r2
notes.content:
- Menus rewritten. Main menu made more intuitive.
- Koth radar rewritten to adapt to terrain. More efficient and accurate.
- Koth radar speed computation revised slightly.
- Player name characters not in chosen font shown as #.
- Rocks look good from underneath.
- Tree trunks made (a bit) rounder.
